lines.beaver: 김 과장님 댁에 초상이 났대요. 들으셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: I heard Manager Kim's family had a death. Did you hear?
lines.beaver_roman: Gim gwajangnim daege chosangi natdaeyo. Deureusyeosseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, I heard this morning. It's a three-day funeral.

lines.beaver_en: When should we go to the house of mourning?
lines.learner: 오늘 일을 끝낸 후에야 비로소 갈 수 있겠어요.
lines.en: I can only go after I finish today's work.
lines.roman: Oneul ireul kkeunnaen hueya biroso gal ssu itgesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How will you give your condolence money?
lines.en: It'd be nice to collect it together as a team.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 팀 경조사 담당이니까 제가 공지할게요.
lines.beaver_en: Sounds good. I handle the team's family events, so I'll announce it.
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo. Tim gyeongjosa damdanginikka jega gongjihalgeyo.
lines.en: Thanks. A black suit should be fine, right?

lines.beaver: 네, 화려한 장신구는 빼고 가요. 조문은 처음이세요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, and leave off any flashy accessories. Is this your first time paying condolences?
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, hwaryeohan jangsinguneun ppaego gayo. Jomuneun cheoeumiseyo?
lines.learner: 네, 처음이라 무슨 말을 해야 할지 모르겠어요.
lines.en: Yes, it's my first time, so I don't know what to say.
lines.roman: Ne, cheoeumira museun mareul haeya halji moreugesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 말은 짧게 하고 고개 숙여 인사하면 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: Keep your words short and just bow your head.
lines.beaver_roman: Mareun jjalge hago gogae sugyeo insahamyeon dwaeyo.
lines.learner: 아, 조용히 마음을 전하는 게 예의군요.
lines.en: Ah, so quietly showing how you feel is the proper etiquette.
lines.roman: A, joyonghi maeumeul jeonhaneun ge yeuigunyo.

lines.beaver: 발인은 모레 아침이래요. 장지까지 가실 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: The funeral procession is the morning after tomorrow. Will you go all the way to the burial site?
lines.beaver_roman: Barineun more achimiraeyo. Jangjikkaji gasil kkeoyeyo?
lines.en: That would be hard, so I'll just go pay my respects today.

lines.beaver: 참, 이번 주 송년회는 미루는 게 좋겠죠?
lines.beaver_en: Oh, we should probably postpone this week's year-end party, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Cham, ibeon ju songnyeonhoeneun miruneun ge joketjyo?
lines.learner: 네, 장례가 다 끝난 후에야 하는 게 맞아요.
lines.en: Yes, it's only right to hold it after the funeral is completely over.
lines.roman: Ne, jangnyega da kkeunnan hueya haneun ge majayo.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 과장님이 복귀하시면 다 같이 위로해 드려요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. When Manager Kim comes back, let's all comfort him together.
lines.beaver_roman: Majayo. Gwajangnimi bokgwihasimyeon da gachi wirohae deuryeoyo.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 그때 따뜻한 밥이라도 한번 사 드려요.
lines.en: Sure. Let's treat him to a warm meal then.
lines.roman: Joayo. Geuttae ttatteutan babirado hanbeon sa deuryeoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 오늘은 퇴근 후에 같이 상갓집에 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Then let's go to the house of mourning together after work today.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom oneureun toegeun hue gachi sanggatjibe gayo.
lines.learner: 네, 여섯 시에 일 층 로비에서 만나요.
lines.en: Okay, let's meet in the first-floor lobby at six.
lines.roman: Ne, yeoseot sie il cheung robieseo mannayo.
